steps: Solubility is the number of grams of a solute that dissolve in 100 g of a solvent to form a saturated solution at a particular temperature.
The solubility of most solid solutes in water increases as the temperature increases.
The solubility of some solids may decrease with an increase in temperature.
items.finalAnswer: Solubility is the number of grams of solute that dissolve in 100 g of solvent to form a saturated solution at a particular temperature. The solubility of most solids increases with temperature.

steps: Molecules of both gases and liquids have translational, rotational and vibrational motions.
Gas molecules move freely and randomly in all directions.
Liquid molecules also move randomly, but their movement is more restricted than that of gas molecules.
items.finalAnswer: Gaseous and liquid molecules have translational, rotational and vibrational motions.

steps: Organic chemistry is the branch of chemistry that deals with the study of hydrocarbons and their derivatives.
Inorganic chemistry deals with the study of all elements and their compounds, except organic compounds.
items.finalAnswer: Organic chemistry studies hydrocarbons and their derivatives, whereas inorganic chemistry studies all elements and their compounds except organic compounds.

steps: Dissolve the impure potassium nitrate in the minimum amount of hot water.
Filter the hot solution to remove insoluble impurities.
Allow the clear filtrate to cool. Potassium nitrate crystals form as the solution cools because its solubility decreases.
Separate the crystals by filtration and dry them.
items.finalAnswer: Impure potassium nitrate is dissolved in hot water, filtered, cooled to form crystals, and then the crystals are filtered and dried.

steps: Graphene is an excellent conductor of electricity.
Its high electrical conductivity and the rapid movement of electrons through it make it useful in electronics.
items.finalAnswer: Graphene’s excellent electrical conductivity makes it very useful in electronics.
